prompts.title: Weekly puppy update
prompts.summary: Turns your weigh-in and notes into a post and an email for the families waiting.
prompts.prompt: Write this week's puppy update for [kennel]. Litter: [parents, born date]. Notes per puppy: [collar color, weight, what they did this week]. Write a short email to the waitlist families (warm, specific, one photo note per puppy) and a post caption (no prices, no pressure). Never promise a puppy's future size, health or temperament.
prompts.use: Send every Monday after weigh-in. Families share these.

prompts.title: Buyer questionnaire
prompts.summary: A questionnaire for families on the waitlist, written in your words.
prompts.prompt: Write a buyer questionnaire for [kennel], a [breed] breeder. I want to know: home and yard, work schedule, other pets, kids, experience with the breed, who the main caretaker is, vet they'll use, and what they'd do if they couldn't keep the dog. Friendly, 12 questions at most, with a note that I return every family's call.
prompts.use: Link it from your waitlist page.

prompts.title: Go-home packet
prompts.summary: A packet for the day a puppy goes home: food, schedule, first week and who to call.
prompts.prompt: Write a go-home packet for a [breed] puppy from [kennel] going home at [weeks] weeks. Include: the food and amounts we use [ ], the daily schedule, crate and potty tips for the first week, what the puppy has had from our vet [ ] and what's next (ask your vet), what's in the bag, and my number. Tell families to follow their own vet's advice.
prompts.use: Print it and email it the same day.
